ShortDescription.Value: Draw a shape and get a finished parking lot inside it: bays, aisles, cross roads and surfaces. The cars really park in it.

Publish.LongDescription:
Draw a shape on the ground and the mod fills it with a complete parking lot: parking bays, driving aisles, cross roads, a road around the edge and the two ground surfaces. The bays are real parking lanes, so cars actually drive in and park there - they are not decoration.
# How to use it
1. Click the parking icon in the mod bar at the top left, or press Ctrl+P. 2. Left click sets the corners of your area, right click takes the last one back. Click the first corner again to close the shape. 3. Place at least one entrance where the lot should meet an existing road. 4. Press Enter, or the Build button.
Before you build you can drag any corner or any edge to reshape the lot, and the preview follows. ESC leaves the tool.
# What you can change
**Layout** - edge setback, row angle (follow an edge, or a fixed angle), aisle width, cross road width, and a cross road every N bays.
**Green** - a median between the bay rows and how deep it is, and the small grass caps where a row meets a cross road. Switch the caps off and the bays sit straight against the cross road instead.
**Surfaces** - pick any of the game's surfaces for the driving area and for everything in between, or switch either one off and paint the ground yourself.
**Bay markings** - the painted stall markings, on or off.
Every value can be saved as your own default, so the next lot starts the way you like it.
# Good to know
- The whole lot has a single owner: one click selects it, one bulldoze removes it. - The panel is English by default. German can be chosen in the mod options. - Something looks wrong? The "Report a problem" tab lets you mark the spot in the world and writes a short text file you can send along.
# Requirements
Unified Icon Library.
# Source
The full source is on GitHub under GPL-3.0. This mod was written with AI assistance and I would rather say so than have someone find out. That is not the same as letting a model improvise until it compiles: the repository documents what was measured, what was decompiled and which wrong turns cost days. You are welcome to check.
